professionalSummary.text: Develops and maintains alert queue and case views for compliance web application using TypeScript and Angular, implementing server-side paging and column virtualization to replace full-queue downloads.
professionalSummary.witness: Developed and maintained the alert queue and case views of the compliance web application (TypeScript, Angular), including the server-side paging and column virtualisation that replaced the full-queue download.

professionalSummary.text: Owns component and end-to-end test suites (Jest and Cypress), maintaining passing status in pipeline and adding queue-load smoke tests that gate releases.
professionalSummary.witness: Owned the component test suite (Jest) and the end-to-end suite (Cypress) for the application, keeping both passing in the pipeline and adding a queue-load smoke test that gates releases.

professionalSummary.text: Reduced median alert-queue load time from 6.2 seconds to 1.4 seconds through server-side paging implementation, measured against published performance baseline using real-user monitoring.
professionalSummary.witness: Median alert-queue load time for analysts fell from 6.2 seconds to 1.4 seconds after the paging release, measured by the application's real-user monitoring over the following four weeks against the published baseline of 6.2 seconds.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinates API changes with backend team through API reviews, adapting frontend views to paged endpoints after backend approval.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated API changes with the backend team in the API review; the backend lead approved endpoint changes and I adapted the views to the paged endpoints.

professionalSummary.text: Documents release notes including known limitations (e.g., column sorting applied per page) and hand-over conditions for frontend on-call.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the release notes for each application release, including the known limitation that column sorting was applied per page rather than across the whole queue, and the hand-over notes for the frontend on-call.

experienceHighlights.text: Implemented server-side paging and column virtualization to replace full-queue downloads, reducing median load time from 6.2s to 1.4s against published baseline.
experienceHighlights.witness: Developed and maintained the alert queue and case views of the compliance web application (TypeScript, Angular), including the server-side paging and column virtualisation that replaced the full-queue download. Median alert-queue load time for analysts fell from 6.2 seconds to 1.4 seconds after the paging release, measured by the application's real-user monitoring over the following four weeks against the published baseline of 6.2 seconds.

experienceHighlights.text: Added queue-load smoke test to Cypress suite, which gates releases and maintains test suite passing status in pipeline.
experienceHighlights.witness: Owned the component test suite (Jest) and the end-to-end suite (Cypress) for the application, keeping both passing in the pipeline and adding a queue-load smoke test that gates releases.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented release limitations (column sorting per page) and hand-over conditions for frontend on-call in release notes.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the release notes for each application release, including the known limitation that column sorting was applied per page rather than across the whole queue, and the hand-over notes for the frontend on-call.
